title: GST Invoice Check
summary: Checks an Indian GST invoice for the wrong tax head (CGST + SGST vs IGST), a rate not in force on the invoice date, and amounts that don't add up.
description: Compares the supplier GSTIN's state with the place of supply to pick CGST + SGST/UTGST or IGST (SEZ and exports always IGST), checks each rate against the slabs in force on the invoice date, LUT exports, the CGST/SGST split and the totals, with a one-tap fix.
catches: Intra-state vs inter-state head chosen wrongly from GSTIN state and place of supply
UTGST vs SGST for union territories without a legislature
Rate not in the slab set for the invoice date (pre-22 Sep 2025, GST 2.0, from 1 Feb 2026)
CGST/SGST not split evenly, or line amounts and total that don't add up
limits: Checks that a rate exists in a slab set, not that it is the right rate for the HSN/SAC
Does not validate the GSTIN on the GST portal
Ignores cess, reverse charge and composition cases
Rule tables are baked in; future rate changes need a code update
a11y: Section labelled by its title; tax table uses column headers
Findings list is a polite live region with icons that are decorative

sources.label: Notification 19/2025-Central Tax (Rate), 31 Dec 2025 (28%/14% schedule omitted, tobacco to 40%, biris to 18% from 1 Feb 2026)
CBIC GST goods and services rates

rules.note: Informational; check the official source. Verified: the 1 Feb 2026 change. The 22 Sep 2025 GST 2.0 slab set (Notification 9/2025-CT(R)) and the UTGST state-code list were not re-fetched this round.

stops: Helps catch a GST invoice under the wrong tax head
